message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. The first blocks authentication to DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. The second then blocks authentication to the database, file server, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server credential-leak route open, since stolen_admin bypasses its patch; mfa:dbadmin alone leaves the DC/ADFS bypass open. Any other single control leaves the DC/ADFS route available: phishing bypasses mfa:user, and segmentation alone can be bypassed by escalating an unpatched workstation or laptop."}
